target_requirements.title: Source-derived app/reference qualification
target_requirements.contract: Compiler descriptors, independent examples, canonical state, authority, browser/MCP/forms and recovery must execute before advertised original workflows qualify. Docs uses checked declarations and existing locale resolver; no business execution, invented availability or localized MCP expansion.

target_requirements.title: Build and installed dependency closure
target_requirements.contract: Explicit acyclic build/export/lock/release inventory includes actual values binding and work-kernel plus every installed runtime/docs producer; no checkout-relative producer assumptions or state-to-full-work dependency.

target_requirements.title: Installed release facts and producer resolution
target_requirements.contract: Build-time owning release facts and producer asset inventory ship in the distribution and resolve through installed package exports. Tree release checks remain development/release tools; outside-checkout CLI does not require compiler/Cargo.toml or packages/* siblings. Target declarations remain capability authority.

target_requirements.title: Typed text/binary inventory and integrity
target_requirements.contract: One contracts-owned asset representation carries kind, logical relative path, content, exact byte length/hash/version. Text-only v1 bytes/hashes/order/string.length remain unchanged; mixed format is versioned and cannot reinterpret Wasm bytes as JS. Hashes establish equality against owning release inputs, not unprovided authenticity.

target_requirements.title: Actual values/work startup and installed consumers
target_requirements.contract: Actual generated glue+Wasm ships and instantiates at startup before synchronous exports; Node/Bun/package imports/local workerd/deployed inventory/testkit consume final bytes. Tiny fixture is prerequisite only. Selected backend checks release/ABI/integrity before semantic work and fails visibly; no implicit TS retry.

target_requirements.title: Preparation demand order and retained host semantics
target_requirements.contract: Prepared TS and one native job preserve current artifact/companion/compat/confirmation/activation/module/Bun/catalog/plan/prior/review/publication/apply order, errors and observable host/library getter/proxy/callback traces. Host producers retain authority; native cannot certify active status or fill missing schedules/routes.

target_requirements.title: Native selected-profile semantic work
target_requirements.contract: Port artifact/index/identity/compat/release/module/plan/render/review calculations through ordered lossless transport; retain admitted unknown metadata, UTF-16 keys/lone surrogates, JS enumeration, f64 bits and canonical number spellings; no generic serde renderer parity or per-leaf IPC. Native realization is required for accepted four-port outcome; default adoption is separately conditional.

target_requirements.title: Preparation process and publication lifecycle
target_requirements.contract: Resolved executable and argv launch, bounded length framing/stage token-once protocol/stderr/private resources; abort/crash/EOF/timeout/cancel cleans owned staging and terminates process. Reviewed bytes publish unchanged with containment/hash checks. Bare/preview/mismatch write no deployment files; failed apply preserves honest manual recovery. Current partial writes are not transactional.

target_requirements.title: Qualified native distribution and full installed journeys
target_requirements.contract: Prebuilt native outputs/notices/permissions/ABI/release/integrity manifest packaged; actual supported-host build+launch and full CLI journeys outside checkout need no user compiler. Initial host candidates linux-x86_64 and macos-aarch64, qualified only on raw evidence. TS host contract survives; native selected on unqualified/missing/corrupt/skew/wrong-arch output fails initialization.

target_requirements.title: Mixed preparation joined to final Wasm delivery
target_requirements.contract: When selected values/work product uses Wasm, both host/native preparation and installed publication preserve actual final mixed assets and load them. Native JS-only may qualify separately as intermediate release, rejects unsupported mixed profile before evaluation and cannot close finished selected-port product.

target_requirements.title: Conformance and whole-consumer measurement
target_requirements.contract: Freeze caller-derived workload/resources and independent observations before comparison; current/prepared TS/native including cold startup, conversion, IPC, Bun/catalog, storage, disk, p95 errors and package size. Effectful callbacks/commits execute once; compare inert captured snapshots only. Historical tests do not certify fresh ports.

target_requirements.title: Explicit subsystem release/rollback
target_requirements.contract: Single backend per request/job; rollback release config across identical rows/artifacts/plans, no data migration unless separately versioned; errors never retry in another engine. Gate default on full parity/installed/support/resource and independently recorded adoption reason.

target_requirements.title: Installed source migrations, maintenance and upgrade recovery
target_requirements.contract: Pin source-owned exact predecessor/desired schema, validate full staged state and compatible pending work, close admissions for accepted maintenance, stage/publish under authoritative fences and resume recorded failures. Installed activation/application consumes these real producer results; current live refusal/inactive verdict cannot qualify finish. Enhanced online/universal transfer and optional Rust scheduler W09 remain separate.

target_requirements.title: Speed-led or native-consumer default
target_requirements.contract: Default Rust selected only after ratified budget and whole-consumer measurements or concrete native consumer/reuse justification with cost limits. Provisional 20% median/10% p95 are not promised speed or a frozen universal budget.

target_requirements.title: Intermediate native JS-only release
target_requirements.contract: May complete native JS-only profile without C04 tiny Wasm proof; mixed is visibly unavailable and profile selection rejects it before evaluation. This release cannot discharge D-MIXED/D-BOOT for selected Wasm product.

target_requirements.title: Bundled native packaging choice
target_requirements.contract: Provisional dist/preparation/<host> route matches P09 and existing files:[dist]. Triple JEV supports qualified opt-in universally but split/low-confidence bundled-vs-optional-package advice remains unsettled. Actual package-size/install/resolver matrix must settle choice before release cutover.

target_requirements.title: Additional formats/engines and publication redesign
target_requirements.contract: Localized MCP/artifact description migration, arbitrary JS helper replacement, stricter artifacts/prior plans, new persisted hashes, transactional publication, universal native host coverage, new root Cargo workspace, optional Rust scheduler W09 and enhanced online/universal transfer remain separate scoped designs. Source migrations, pinned predecessor, compatible old work, bounded fenced maintenance and installed staging/activation/upgrade recovery are REQUIRED D-UPGRADE, not deferred.

target_requirements.title: Unsafe shortcuts
target_requirements.contract: Decline smoke=>real asset certification, checkout=>installed certification, Node>=22=>universal native support, native process success=>active app, marker-only MCP proof, hidden semantic fallback, duplicate observable execution, cloned catalog/locale authority and four-port narrow profile=>finished product completion.

findings.claim: CSV UI leaves plus existing operation endpoint
findings.observation: Existing presentation CsvImportReview contains only captions and string cells; collections csvImport renders upload/caller-parsed preview. DESIGN requires authorized pure candidate review before every confirmed row, mapping/exclusions and renewed confirmation on changed candidates, frozen row identity/current authority and independent outcomes.
findings.correction: Add server-owned CSV preflight/read-review envelope and route join; retain original canonical per-row operation invocation, not a batch CRUD engine.

findings.observation: ui/htmx pollTrigger emits GET attributes; comments explicitly leave inactivity pausing to browser/runtime. refreshTrigger returns cadence only. Accepted DESIGN requires authorized poll checkpoint/current context, one inflight chain/deliveries, fresh repeat identity with stable retry, visibility/context/logout termination and obsolete projection/action-handle invalidation.
findings.correction: Allocate browser polling/refresh lifecycle exact owner and installed server read/projection join, preserving form/focus/unsaved state.

findings.claim: Product interface table is complete for accepted browser duties
findings.observation: DESIGN CSV-export and Print clauses require checkpoint/current row-field/file grants, bounded complete pagination or truthful incomplete status, formula protection, typed identifiers/version/currency columns; large export uses persisted status and expiring authorized download. Product table does not allocate these duties.
findings.correction: Add authorized read export/print owners; browser can request/print declared content but cannot certify server completeness or access. Work/files participate only for large persisted outputs.

findings.claim: Identity system modules register constrained commands with canonical transaction port
findings.observation: Identity D1 explicitly says feature operations lack J2 fence. Void consumed-token updates do not expose winner; recovery changes password before consumption/cascaded revokes. State SystemStaging carries domain model writes and receipt:null; SystemRunContext actor/operation strings are caller-provided. Registering a name alone supplies neither verified auth context, identity_* atomic write support nor replayable credential outcome.
findings.correction: Freeze typed constrained identity transaction/conditional-consume results + context/replay/failure policy and D1 fence integration before new commands. Preserve identity table/store authority and no raw SQL feature API; anonymous proof does not gain synthetic business actor.

findings.claim: State preference schema/commands/reads plus settings route sufficient
findings.observation: Compiler currently emits preference literal defaults as admit bindings and emits schemas/validators. UI settings accepts trusted controls/caller URLs. REQUIREMENTS/DESIGN require self/app/canonical owner/team key, finite allowed types/defaults, pure preference validation and actual presentation consumer, current reference checks/fallback, canonical bound-tab saves and cancel/reset/version outcomes; base account settings are separately shared.
findings.correction: Keep compiler checked descriptor/validator producer and current context lookup in target; never read live user preferences from author-time defaults or allow persisted settings to affect business authority. New runtime reads replace default-only consumer where appropriate without discarding defaults.

findings.claim: New browser source modules can be qualified by UI owner alone
findings.observation: Current ui client DOM-free library leaves URLs/DOM swap to caller; shell HTML uses component markup but inspected render does not install the browser bootstrap/CSS/runtime assets. Current release/vendor inventories omit native work and binary paths and only walk producer JS.
findings.correction: Add emitted browser entry/CSS/HTMX dependency inventory, static route/asset delivery and actual installed browser load gate. Pinned catalog includes interaction contracts, not evidence scripts are assembled.
